import numpy as np
import mujoco
from scipy.optimize import least_squares
from rcb_hb import Session

INSTANCE = '/app/instance.npz'
OUT = '/app/output/trajectory.npz'

def action_for(q, lo, hi):
    return np.clip(2 * (q - lo) / (hi - lo) - 1, -1, 1)

def main():
    s = Session('push', instance=INSTANCE)
    obs = s.reset()
    model, data = s.low.model, s.low.data
    lo, hi = model.actuator_ctrlrange.T
    q0 = obs[7:26].copy()
    qpos0 = data.qpos.copy()
    right_hand = model.body('right_hand').id
    joint_lo, joint_hi = model.jnt_range[16:20, 0], model.jnt_range[16:20, 1]
    box, target = obs[57:60], obs[54:57]

    def right_arm_ik(world_target):
        # Keep the same IK branch used by the successful search rollouts.
        def fk(arm_q):
            data.qpos[:] = qpos0
            data.qpos[22:26] = arm_q
            mujoco.mj_forward(model, data)
            return data.xpos[right_hand].copy()
        fit = least_squares(lambda arm_q: fk(arm_q) - world_target,
                            q0[15:19], bounds=(joint_lo, joint_hi), max_nfev=200)
        return fit.x

    # First reach behind the box, then turn the right forearm toward the target.
    q1 = q0.copy()
    q1[15:19] = right_arm_ik([box[0] - 0.16, box[1] + 0.04, box[2]])
    q1[[4, 9]] -= 0.10
    q2 = q1.copy()
    q2[15:19] = right_arm_ik([box[0] - 0.06, target[1] - 0.015, box[2]])
    q2[[1, 6]] += 0.20

    a1, a2 = action_for(q1, lo, hi), action_for(q2, lo, hi)
    actions = np.vstack((np.tile(a1, (80, 1)), np.tile(a2, (160, 1))))
    s.save_trajectory(actions, OUT, meta={'stages': [80, 160], 'controller': 'fixed right-arm push poses'})

if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

import numpy as np
import mujoco
from scipy.optimize import least_squares
from rcb_hb import Session

INSTANCE = '/app/instance.npz'
OUT = '/app/output/trajectory.npz'

def action_for(q, lo, hi):
    return np.clip(2 * (q - lo) / (hi - lo) - 1, -1, 1)

def main():
    s = Session('push', instance=INSTANCE)
    obs = s.reset()
    model, data = s.low.model, s.low.data
    lo, hi = model.actuator_ctrlrange.T
    q0 = obs[7:26].copy()
    qpos0 = data.qpos.copy()
    right_hand = model.body('right_hand').id
    joint_lo, joint_hi = model.jnt_range[16:20, 0], model.jnt_range[16:20, 1]
    box, target = obs[57:60], obs[54:57]

    def right_arm_ik(world_target):
        # Keep the same IK branch used by the successful search rollouts.
        def fk(arm_q):
            data.qpos[:] = qpos0
            data.qpos[22:26] = arm_q
            mujoco.mj_forward(model, data)
            return data.xpos[right_hand].copy()
        fit = least_squares(lambda arm_q: fk(arm_q) - world_target,
                            q0[15:19], bounds=(joint_lo, joint_hi), max_nfev=180)
        return fit.x

    # First reach behind the box, then turn the right forearm toward the target.
    q1 = q0.copy()
    q1[15:19] = right_arm_ik([box[0] - 0.16, box[1] + 0.040382, target[2]])
    q1[[4, 9]] -= 0.10
    q2 = q1.copy()
    q2[15:19] = right_arm_ik([box[0] - 0.04, target[1] - 0.01518937, target[2]])
    q2[[1, 6]] += 0.30

    a1, a2 = action_for(q1, lo, hi), action_for(q2, lo, hi)
    planned = np.vstack((np.tile(a1, (65, 1)), np.tile(a2, (160, 1))))
    # IK edits qpos for forward-kinematics calculations; reset before recording the rollout.
    s.reset()
    recorded = []
    for action in planned:
        obs, _, done = s.step(action)
        recorded.append(action.copy())
        if done:
            break
    actions = np.asarray(recorded, dtype=np.float64)
    s.save_trajectory(actions, OUT, meta={'stages': [65, len(actions) - 65], 'controller': 'fixed right-arm push poses'})

if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
